fieldValues.title: Domain container: identity is the domain record, clusters as outline
fieldValues.decision_question: How is a domain modelled as a container, and how do we close the identity gap?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (clerk#32), walked one decision at a time; awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: 2a: agent-created domain container with the existing method/domain record as identity. 2b identity gap: (A) leave the identity naming as a suggestion and let readers resolve via canon()/derived-from; (B) fix core fork replaceIn now.
fieldValues.decision_statement: The domain container has the existing method/domain record as identity. An agent creates it with container create, containerType com.semanticops.method/domain. Clusters sit at depth 0 and problems at depth 1. Switch the srs-web buildBoard and the roadmap.mjs cluster lookup to the outline, then delete the domain to cluster and cluster to problem contains edges in the same data change. For the identity gap take A: leave the identity naming as a suggestion and resolve through canon()/derived-from. The core fork replaceIn change is deferred until a reader that does not use canon() (domain rendering) needs it.
fieldValues.rationale: One way per goal: the outline replaces the contains edges in one change. The core change is not needed yet.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a non-canon reader, such as domain rendering, needs the identity resolved.
